follow_up_questions.question: Do you know the exact name or strength of the steroid cream you used (for example, hydrocortisone 1% versus a stronger betamethasone)?
follow_up_questions.reasoning: Knowing potency and previous response clarifies whether treatment failure reflects inadequate strength (supporting eczema) or refractoriness (suggesting an alternative diagnosis such as contact dermatitis or infection).
